harness.name: Claude-AD
harness.description: Active Directory pentest playbook for Claude Code as skills, agents and slash commands.

uses.quote: Once installed, the skills load automatically when you work on an AD engagement, and the commands (`/ad-scope`, `/ad-recon`, `/ad-attack-paths`) are available.
Every AD assessment follows the same spine: map before you exploit, harvest the easy credentials before you spray, collect the graph before you reason about paths.
